'''Cineni''' is an [[Afro-Asiatic language]] spoken in [[Borno State]], [[Nigeria]] in the single village of [[Cineni]].<ref name=e18/>  In a 2006 paper, [[Roger Blench]] classified it as a dialect of [[Guduf-Gava language|Guduf-Gava]].<ref>Blench, 2006. [http://rogerblench.info/Language/Afroasiatic/General/AALIST.pdf The Afro-Asiatic Languages: Classification and Reference List] (ms)</ref>
